title: Volverse + Adjective for Personality and Character Shifts

sections.content:
Use **volverse + adjetivo** for transformations in character, attitude, or psychological state that are radical and lasting:

• **Personality changes**: *Se ha vuelto muy desconfiado con los años.* (He has become very distrustful over the years.) *Con la fama se volvió arrogante.* (With fame he became arrogant.)
• **Mental state / Obsession**: *Esa música me vuelve loco.* (That music drives me crazy.) *Se volvió loco de amor.* (He went mad with love.)
• **Difficulty/Condition**: *La situación se ha vuelto insoportable.* (The situation has become unbearable.)

items.spanish: Desde que ganó la lotería, se ha vuelto muy tacaño.
items.english: Ever since he won the lottery, he has become very stingy.

items.spanish: Con la edad, mi abuela se volvió mucho más tolerante.
items.english: With age, my grandmother became much more tolerant.

items.spanish: El tráfico en la ciudad se está volviendo imposible.
items.english: Traffic in the city is becoming impossible.

sections.content: *Volverse* implies a lasting change in essence or behavior, unlike the temporary nature of *ponerse*.
